lines.label: Tax K3 (GST on air transport)
lines.basis: DGCA-CAR-S3-M-II — Statutory taxes and airport charges are refundable on cancellation, non-utilisation or no-show, INCLUDING on promotional and special fares where the basic fare is non-refundable. Obligation attaches to the operating permit (Rule 133A of the Aircraft Rules, 1937), not to fare filing, so it binds this carrier regardless of PSS.

evidence.content_verification: VERIFIED: every fee figure asserted by this rule is present in the preserved copy.
evidence.why_it_matches: Carrier SG matches; market DOMESTIC matches; fare family SAVER matches ['*']; applicability keyed to BOOKING_DATE (2025-12-20) falls inside this rule's stated window; cancellation at T-120.00h selects its band.
caveats: BEST EVIDENCE OF ANY CARRIER: SpiceJet's own live page retains both the old and new fee values with explicit booking-date boundaries.

The >96h figure (3899) and the <96h figure (4899) come from two different statements on the same page; their band assignment is the most plausible reading but was not cross-verified against a single table.

Condition A of the published table (nil cancellation fee within 24h of booking when departure is more than seven days away) is encoded as `free_look`. It cannot be evaluated without the booking TIME, which most documents do not print — in that case the engine reports the condition as unevaluated rather than assuming it does not apply.
